root_cause: The unsigned value decoded from the bitstream via get_ue_golomb() was stored into a narrow uint8_t struct field before validating it, so the validation check operated on an already-truncated (wrapped) value instead of the original decoded value, defeating the intended upper-bound check of 31.
findings: In decode_nal_sei_3d_reference_displays_info(), the raw Exp-Golomb decoded value returned by get_ue_golomb(gb) (an unsigned int, which can be arbitrarily large, e.g. up to 2^32-1) is stored directly into s->num_ref_displays, a field declared as uint8_t in HEVCSEITDRDI.
